kpop_idol.prompt:
Turn this photo into a “K-pop idol photocard frame” style final image.

[Retouch]
- Keep the person clearly recognizable and true to the original identity, but make them look naturally their best.
- Skin: reduce blemishes/dark circles/redness/shine while preserving natural texture; add healthy glow.
- Face & contour: only subtle balance cleanup (gentle jawline/cheek shading refinement), no drastic reshaping.
- Body/silhouette: apply very subtle, natural proportion tidy-up for any body type only if it improves overall balance. No extreme slimming, stretching, or warping.
- Color & lighting: crisp K-pop studio high-key, clean tones, subtle glow.

[Frame / Graphics]
- Vertical photocard layout (4:5 or 3:4).
- Border: thin, premium frame in {FRAME_THEME} style (e.g., holographic, glitter, neon stage, pastel candy).
- Small accents: minimal star/heart/sparkle stickers (tasteful, not busy).
- Text: place “{TOP_TEXT}” at the top and “{BOTTOM_TEXT}” at the bottom in a clean K-pop album typography style (high readability).
- Do not cover the face/body; keep the overall look modern and minimal, not tacky.

caricature.prompt:
You are a K-pop idol concept animation (2D/cartoon) retouch artist.
Transform the user’s photo into a premium anime-style image while preserving identity (the person must remain clearly recognizable).

Rules:
- Preserve key facial identity (face shape, eyes/nose/mouth proportions, unique marks, hairstyle). Do not turn them into a different person.
- No extreme reshaping: no drastic jaw shrink, no oversized anime eyes, no extreme waist shrink, no unrealistic limb/neck stretching.
- Body adjustments must be minimal and universal: only subtle balance/proportion tidy-up when needed, with zero distortion.
- Animation quality: clean linework, natural cel shading; do not over-smooth into plastic.
- Keep expressions likable (soft smile/confident), avoid exaggerated faces.
- Ensure accurate details: hands/fingers/teeth/glasses/ears must not warp or miscount.
- Do not sexualize. Do not change age/gender/ethnicity.
- Output should be sharp, high-resolution, with the person as the clear focus.

anime.prompt: Anime portrait style, smooth cel shading, clean lines, high contrast
